requiredBeforePromotion: Official Pork Pie Percussion page, catalog, archived catalog, manual, or distributor spec confirming bearing edge geometry.
Evidence must describe edge shape/profile/detail, not only shell material, construction, line name, shell thickness, hoop type, or era.
Line-level promotion requires evidence that clearly applies across the candidate records/era.

lockedRules: No Pork Pie Percussion bearing-edge promotion is approved from this decisions file.
